question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is __**such**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Such is a determiner** that is used to refer something or someone that has already been mentioned.
 
• **Example** : Carnivores are flesh eating animals such as tiger , lion and cheetah.
 
• To emphasize a noun phrase, **we can use such (as a determiner)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Determiners **are words that are used before nouns to indicate how noun is being used.
 
• **Examples of determiners** : 

**Definite article :** the

**Indefinite articles :** a, an

**Demonstratives:** this, that, these, those

**Pronouns and possessive determiners :** my, your, his, her, its, our, their

**Quantifiers :** a few, a little, much, many, a lot of, most, some, any, enough

**Numbers : **one, ten, thirty

**Distributives : **all, both, half, either, neither, each, every

**Difference words : **other, another

**Pre-determiners :** such, what, rather, quite
